messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content:
請問您是想知道哪一項比賽的冠軍？  
- 2015 年世界國際象棋錦標賽（World Chess Championship）  
- 2015 年國際象棋奧林匹克（Chess Olympiad）  

還是其他「國際象棋錦標賽」？
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want who won the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Actually "國際象棋錦標賽" could refer to World Chess Championship or Chess Olympiad. But likely they mean the 2015 World Chess Championship? That was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. Or maybe they refer to the 2015 Chess Olympiad held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The team gold was Russia. So answer depends on interpretation. The question is ambiguous. We can ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question if ambiguous. So respond asking which event.
